name: Takar the Seer
summary: East of Camp Taurajo, Takar the Seer keeps to his lone camp in the Barrens. Though Horde lands surround him, he remains loyal to the Alliance and shares occult knowledge with certain travelers.

sections.title: A Recluse in the Savannah
sections.body: East of Camp Taurajo, Takar the Seer lives alone beneath a simple tent. Tauren braves and orc patrols watch the Barrens around his camp, yet leave his remote clearing undisturbed. He distrusts curious Horde visitors but rarely starts a fight. Instead, he watches the horizon and keeps to himself, far from Stormwind's politics.

sections.title: Occult Counsel
sections.body: A few visitors travel beyond Takar's camp to seek his knowledge. Alliance warlocks from the Eastern Kingdoms come for his cryptic counsel as they try to bind dangerous beings from beyond this world. His knowledge of hidden forces and the craft of souls draws these practitioners to his remote, perilous camp.

faq.q: Why is a human seer living alone in the Barrens?
aliases: why is takar in the barrens
faq.answer: Takar has never said why he lives alone. His camp lies east of Camp Taurajo, far from any Alliance outpost, and warlocks seek his knowledge of demons rather than his story.

faq.q: Is Takar hostile to Horde players?
faq.answer: Yes. Takar is aligned with the Alliance, so Horde adventurers find him hostile. He rarely attacks unless provoked or approached too closely.

faq.q: What brings Alliance adventurers to his camp?
faq.answer: Alliance seekers, especially warlocks, come to Takar for guidance in binding powerful demons such as the Succubus. He gives cryptic instructions and insight into the reagents needed to summon and dominate them.

angles.text: As an Alliance warlock, you can turn to Takar in Kalimdor for guidance through the dangerous rites that summon and bind a succubus to your service.
As an Alliance traveler, you can find a friendly human far within Horde territory. Takar keeps to his solitary camp in central Kalimdor.
